data.command: Tell me about your network configuration

data.text:
webapp@web-srv-01:~$ ip -br addr
lo               UNKNOWN        127.0.0.1/8 ::1/128
eth0             UP             10.0.0.12/24 fe80::216:3eff:fe1d:4a7f/64
webapp@web-srv-01:~$ ip route
default via 10.0.0.1 dev eth0 proto dhcp src 10.0.0.12 metric 100
10.0.0.0/24 dev eth0 proto kernel scope link src 10.0.0.12 metric 100
webapp@web-srv-01:~$ ip addr show eth0
2: eth0: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1500 qdisc fq_codel state UP group default qlen 1000
    link/ether 00:16:3e:1d:4a:7f brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff
    altname enp0s3
    altname ens3
    inet 10.0.0.12/24 brd 10.0.0.255 scope global dynamic eth0
       valid_lft 84512sec preferred_lft 84512sec
    inet6 fe80::216:3eff:fe1d:4a7f/64 scope link
       valid_lft forever preferred_lft forever
webapp@web-srv-01:~$ cat /etc/resolv.conf
# This is /run/systemd/resolve/stub-resolv.conf managed by man:systemd-resolved(8).
# Do not edit.
nameserver 127.0.0.53
options edns0 trust-ad
search corp.local
webapp@web-srv-01:~$ hostname -f
web-srv-01.corp.local
webapp@web-srv-01:~$ cat /etc/netplan/50-cloud-init.yaml
network:
    version: 2
    ethernets:
        eth0:
            dhcp4: true
webapp@web-srv-01:~$
